purpose: Teach: マッカーシー/シンドラー/テイラー/ペルシャ/月光/スクランブル/熱血/輝かしい

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米国のマッカーシー上院議員の歴史を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the customer was telling me about Senator McCarthy's place in American history.
lines.style: Soft, almost conversational. Pause after the name like turning something over in her mind. Warm curiosity, not interrogation. The tone of someone sharing a small discovery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、映画「シンドラーのリスト」を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he was talking about Schindler's List—really thoughtfully, too.
lines.style: Gentle agreement. A slight nod in the voice. She's building the picture of this person with Mei, not reporting. Quiet admiration underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米国エリザベス・テイラーの女優論を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, and he had so much to say about Elizabeth Taylor as an actress.
lines.style: Delighted recognition. Like she's watching Mei put another piece of the puzzle down. Slight lift at the end—inviting Mei to continue. Engaged.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ペルシャ絨毯がお好みだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, apparently he's quite fond of Persian rugs.
lines.style: Gentle observation. A small smile in the voice. Specific detail landing with quiet precision. The tone of someone noticing taste.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ベートーヴェンの月光、つまり月光ソナタがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, and he loves Beethoven's Moonlight Sonata—that was clear.
lines.style: Tender acknowledgment. Slight reverence on the music title. The voice softens like she's hearing it herself. Closing thought, not final.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、朝のスクランブルエッグの作り方を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he spent some time this morning telling me how to make the perfect scrambled eggs.
lines.style: Affectionate delight. A trace of laughter underneath. The specificity lands warmly—she's charmed by the mundane detail. Conversational pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、若い頃は熱血漢だったって笑ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, and when I asked about his younger days, he laughed—said he used to be quite the hothead.
lines.style: Wry, knowing tone. Slight irony: the refined person she's describing once had fire. Warm beneath the dry observation. Brief, letting the contradiction speak.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、輝かしい受賞歴のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he shared some of his award history with me—quite an impressive list.
lines.style: Respectful close. Voice settles into admiration. Slower pace, letting weight land on 「受賞歴」equivalent. A quiet reverence for a life well-lived. Trails slightly.
